nphi.title: EU Twinning: strengthening control of health and environmental risks (ANCSEP, Tunisia)
nphi.actor: France–Netherlands twinning consortium (French Ministry of Health lead)
nphi.with: Agence Nationale de Contrôle Sanitaire et Environnemental des Produits (ANCSEP)
nphi.summary: EUR 1 million EU Twinning (Sept 2015–Sept 2017) under the PACS programme helping Tunisia's ANCSEP improve health and environmental risk assessment and management, including legislative alignment.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 03 – Knowledge development and transfer of best practice on biosafety/biosecurity/biorisk management
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur d'Algérie; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; L. Sacco University Hospital; Expertise France; VERTIC; Thai Department of Medical Sciences; TIDREC University of Malaya; ISTC; STCU; CNESTEN; University of Coimbra
nphi.summary: Early EU CBRN CoE project in which RIVM, North African Pasteur institutes and other partners built laboratory biorisk-management systems and training for 24 partner countries across Africa, Europe's neighbourhood and South-East Asia.

nphi.title: National Inventory of Dangerous Pathogens in North Africa
nphi.with: CRDF Global (US State Dept ISN/CTR funding)
nphi.summary: As a CRDF Global subcontractor, RIVM adapted its Uganda pathogen-inventory software and method, then held consultations with Jordan and Tunisia.

nphi.title: Institut Pasteur de Tunis – INSA Toulouse partnership on industrial biotechnology
nphi.with: INSA Toulouse
nphi.summary: Agreement signed 3 June 2026 for joint projects and exchanges in industrial biotechnology applied to human and plant health.

nphi.title: Africa CDC North Africa Regional Coordinating Centre (Cairo)
nphi.with: Egypt Ministry of Health and Population (host); Tunisia (presidency)
nphi.summary: The North Africa RCC is hosted by Egypt; in June 2025 its steering committee in Cairo approved Tunisia to preside over it.

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 110 – One Health Secure
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); CSIC; IRD; IZS Teramo; AVIA-GIS
nphi.summary: EU CBRN Centres of Excellence project in which Institut Pasteur and Italy's ISS, with veterinary and research partners, help Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel countries prepare for climate-sensitive vector-borne diseases through One…

nphi.title: Health Security Partnership to Strengthen Disease Surveillance in Africa (HSPA)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO (Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence); Canada Weapons Threat Reduction Program; UK government
nphi.summary: WHO, Africa CDC and RKI link health and security sectors for collaborative surveillance (biorisk, event- and indicator-based and genomic surveillance, epidemic intelligence). Phase 1 covered six countries from 2023; phase 2 (2025-2028)…

nphi.title: NAMRU-EURAFCENT – Tunisia joint health cooperation programme
nphi.actor: US Naval Medical Research Unit EURAFCENT (NAMRU-EURAFCENT)
nphi.with: Tunisian Ministry of Health; NAMRU-EURAFCENT Cairo detachment
nphi.summary: Programme launched in 2022 and reaffirmed in February 2025 supporting genomic surveillance of respiratory and febrile illnesses, vector surveillance and vector-borne disease research, and laboratory capacity in Tunisia.

nphi.title: German Biosecurity Programme – African and North African partner countries
nphi.actor: Robert Koch Institute with Bundeswehr Institute of Microbiology, Friedrich-Loeffler-Institut and BNITM
nphi.with: Partner-country laboratories and health authorities; GIZ; German Federal Foreign Office (funder)
nphi.summary: Federal Foreign Office programme (since 2013) in which RKI, IMB, FLI, BNITM and GIZ strengthen biosafety, biosecurity and detection of dangerous pathogens in partner countries; the 2023 flyer lists these African partners alongside others…

nphi.title: Pasteur Network (Institut Pasteur International Network)
nphi.with: Pasteur Network members incl. Institut Pasteur de Dakar, de Bangui, de Côte d'Ivoire, de Guinée, du Maroc, de Madagascar, de Tunis, d'Algérie, du Cambodge, du Laos, Korea, Montevideo, São Paulo; Centre Pasteur du Cameroun; CERMES Niger; Fiocruz; NIHE, Pasteur Institutes Nha Trang and Ho Chi Minh City; Pasteur Institute of Iran; HKU-Pasteur Research Pole; Sciensano; Stephan Angeloff Institute; Hellenic Pasteur Institute; Institut Pasteur in Saint Petersburg
nphi.summary: Global network of about 33 public health and research institutes in 25 countries and territories, many of them national reference laboratories or NPHIs, collaborating on infectious disease surveillance, research and training.

nphi.title: HSPA phase II – public health intelligence trainings in Tunisia and Morocco (2026)
nphi.with: ONMNE Tunisia; DELM Morocco; WHO EMRO; WHO Hub; ECDC; Lebanese Ministry of Public Health
nphi.summary: RKI (ZIG1 leads the epidemic-intelligence work area) delivered PHI Foundations trainings with Tunisia's ONMNE (May 2026) and Morocco's DELM (July 2026), turning phase-I country roadmaps into practice, funded by Canada and the UK.

nphi.title: SPOT – Sequencing for pandemic preparedness with One Health in Tunisia
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur de Tunis
nphi.summary: Built sequencing-based early detection of zoonotic viruses in Tunisia and neighbours.

nphi.title: Africa CDC peer-to-peer and twinning programme between North African NPHIs
nphi.with: National public health institutes of North African AU member states
nphi.summary: Africa CDC programme, financed by the World Bank Africa CDC Support Program (P178633), to establish and strengthen NPHIs in North Africa, including support for peer-to-peer learning and twinning between NPHIs in the region.

nphi.title: RKI–Africa CDC side events at CPHIA 2023 (Lusaka)
nphi.with: Africa CDC; WHO Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence; WHO AFRO and EMRO
nphi.summary: Two side events at the 2023 International Conference on Public Health in Africa presented joint epidemic-intelligence work under HSPA and launched an Africa CDC continental guidance framework for NCD, injury and mental-health surveillance…

nphi.title: EMPHNET FETP exchange: Lebanon FETP leadership visits FETP Tunisia
nphi.with: FETP Lebanon; EMPHNET
nphi.summary: The director and coordinator of FETP Lebanon visited FETP Tunisia under the EMPHNET exchange programme.

nphi.title: EU Initiative on Health Security (2020–2025)
nphi.with: National public health institutes and ministries of health of EU Enlargement and Neighbourhood countries
nphi.summary: DG NEAR-funded €9 million programme through which ECDC built epidemic intelligence, risk assessment, preparedness and field-epidemiology (MediPIET) capacity in 21 neighbourhood and enlargement countries and integrated them into ECDC…

nphi.title: GOARN in the Eastern Mediterranean: partner institutions and 2019-2020 deployments
nphi.actor: GOARN Eastern Mediterranean partner institutions (incl. NIH Pakistan, Institut Pasteur Tunis, EMPHNET)
nphi.with: National Institute of Health Pakistan; Institut Pasteur du Maroc; Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Institut Pasteur of Iran; EMPHNET; Ministries of Health
nphi.summary: 17 partner institutions from 12 countries support outbreak deployments, e.g. 25 experts to the Larkana HIV outbreak in Pakistan, cholera in Yemen, floods in Iran and measles in Tunisia (2019-2020).

nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE Project 075 – MediLabSecure (One Health biological risks in the Mediterranean, Black Sea and Sahel)
nphi.with: Istituto Superiore di Sanità (ISS); IRD; INIA; IZS Teramo; Avia-GIS
nphi.summary: EU-funded network led by Institut Pasteur with Italy's ISS that strengthened laboratories and public health institutions in 22 neighbouring countries to detect and respond to arboviruses and their vectors, including external quality…

nphi.title: PPE – Partnership in postgraduate education
nphi.with: Centre Muraz (Burkina Faso); CHU Bouaké (Côte d'Ivoire); Kinshasa University Hospital (DR Congo); LAUTECH, NCDC, Obafemi Awolowo University, University of Ibadan (Nigeria); Naval Hospital Medical Center (Peru); Epidemiology Bureau DOH (Philippines); University of Pretoria (South Africa); Colombo Teaching Hospital Ragama (Sri Lanka); Central Laboratory (Sudan); Avicenna Tajik State Medical University (Tajikistan); Charles Nicolle Hospital (Tunisia)
nphi.summary: Train-the-trainer postgraduate stays at RKI in lab diagnostics and epidemiology for partner-country scientists.

nphi.title: German–Tunisian biosafety and biosecurity programme
nphi.with: Institut Pasteur de Tunis; Observatoire National des Maladies Nouvelles et Émergentes (ONMNE); Direction des Soins de Santé de Base; GIZ
nphi.summary: Programme under the German Federal Foreign Office's biosecurity initiative, inaugurated in Tunis in 2015, training Tunisian scientists in biorisk management and strengthening outbreak detection and surveillance with IPT and ONMNE.

nphi.title: MediPIET – Mediterranean and Black Sea Programme for Intervention Epidemiology Training
nphi.with: FIIAPP; FCSAI; ECDC (scientific lead); national public health authorities of partner countries
nphi.summary: An EU-initiated field epidemiology fellowship for Mediterranean and Black Sea countries. ISCIII co-implemented it with FIIAPP (2014–2017) and FCSAI (2018–2021); ECDC ran it alone from 2021 to 2025.

nphi.title: NOSOMED – Strengthening healthcare epidemiology and investigation of nosocomial infections in the Mediterranean
nphi.with: Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP) Algeria; CHU Farhat Hached (Tunisia); General Organisation of Teaching Hospitals and Institutes (Egypt); Université Hassan II (Morocco); University of Turin
nphi.summary: EU FP5 international cooperation project building hospital-infection epidemiology capacity in North Africa and Egypt, with Algeria's national public health institute as a partner.
